lyrics.text:
Dia jamah sg’nap hidupku
Dan b’ri damai di hatiku

Semua t’lah berubah dan aku tau
Yesus jamah ‘ku jadi baru

He touched me,
oh He touched me

And all the joy
that floods my soul

Something happened
and now I know

Jesus touched me
and made me whole

Something happened
and now I know

Jesus touched me
and made me whole
